strategies.name: Baseline 8-stage all-reduce chain
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling and uncoupling transformations between stages. Dispatch count: 8 all-reduces. Represents the straightforward "compute-then-communicate" pattern with minimal complexity but no overlap or fusion opportunities.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter plus all-gather decomposition
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, performing local coupling operations on reduced shards between stages (16 dispatches total: 8 reduce-scatter + 8 all-gather). Trades dispatch count for smaller per-dispatch payloads (factor of W reduction in reduce-scatter phase) and potential for better network utilization on hierarchical topologies.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction stages
strategies.desc: Exploits multi-node structure by performing intra-node all-reduces followed by inter-node all-reduces at each of the 8 stages (16 dispatches if num_nodes > 1). Reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure by aggregating within nodes first, trading increased dispatch count for reduced inter-node traffic volume and potentially lower latency on pod-sliced topologies.

strategies.name: Pipelined butterfly with fused transformations
strategies.desc: Uses a butterfly or recursive-halving pattern for each all-reduce stage with local coupling/uncoupling transformations fused into the send/receive buffer preparation (8 dispatches via optimized all-reduce implementations). Reduces memory movement by fusing arithmetic operations with communication buffer preparation, representing a compute-communication fusion tradeoff.

strategies.name: Ring all-reduce with streamed coupling
strategies.desc:
Implements each all-reduce as a ring algorithm (reduce-scatter + all-gather ring pattern) while streaming bidiagonal coupling operations on chunks as they arrive (8 stages × 2 ring phases = 16 logical dispatches, but potentially pipelined). Maximizes bandwidth utilization through chunk-wise pipelining and overlaps computation with communication at chunk granularity.
